_comment: Grafana Cloud Synthetic Monitoring probe for the production API's readiness endpoint (IFC-032 follow-up, #811: 'Availability (an external probe of /health/ready) is not a span-metric rule. It needs a Grafana Synthetic Monitoring check.'). Applied by tools/scripts/observability/apply-synthetic-monitoring.mjs in two steps against two different APIs: (1) the HTTP check itself, created/updated through the Synthetic Monitoring API (POST /api/v1/check/add or /api/v1/check/update at SM_API_URL, auth SM_ACCESS_TOKEN); (2) one Grafana alert rule over the probe_success metric the check publishes to the stack's existing Grafana Cloud Prometheus datasource (grafanacloud-prom), created/updated through the SAME provisioning API infra/monitoring/grafana/cloud/alert-rules.json already uses (GRAFANA_URL/GRAFANA_SA_TOKEN), so it inherits the stack's existing default notification policy (owner's email) rather than defining a new one. Target matches vars.PRODUCTION_API_URL / tools/local-verify/verify-cors-auth.mjs; update it here first if the production domain ever changes. NOT applied yet: Synthetic Monitoring must be initialized on the stack and a publish access token issued first (see docs/observability/README.md and PR #811's body for the two owner steps and the apply command).

alertRule.title: Production /health/ready probe failing
alertRule.summary: The external synthetic probe of the production API's /health/ready endpoint failed at least once from a monitored location in the last 5 minutes.
